description:
In-process integration: one Beadwork ticket from `/bw run` through implementation child settle without tmux, without closing the ticket automatically.

## Background

This is the first vertical slice that proves the two packages together. Review may be exercised if cheap; default ticket review full loop is D-epic-e2e. Do not publish on this slice alone.

## Approach

Temporary git+bw fixture, stub or scripted parent turns if needed, real orchestrate + session factory. Assert:

- no tmux
- orchestrate handle before completion
- parent not blocked
- settlement does not close the issue
- domain metadata present on the child
- `/bw run` injected prompt happened

## Success criteria

- Test is deterministic and logged.
- Works with tmux absent (PATH without tmux).

## Test plan

- Integration under packages/pi-beadwork-extension or a workspace e2e script replacing e2e-current-branch-delegate.

## Considerations

Needs orchestrate + packets + /bw run. Child tool allowlist should already hide close.
title: Prove one in-process ticket from /bw run through child settlement
